events.description: Phoebe Buffay asks what Monica Geller did with Coma Guy.
Monica Geller says Coma Guy is awake.
Phoebe Buffay tells Coma Guy to look at himself.
Phoebe Buffay asks how Coma Guy feels.
Monica Geller says Coma Guy looks good.
Coma Guy says Coma Guy feels good.
Coma Guy asks who Phoebe Buffay and Monica Geller are.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is Phoebe Buffay.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is Monica Geller.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller has been taking care of Coma Guy.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay have both been taking care of Coma Guy.
Coma Guy asks whether the Etch-a-Sketch is from Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says the Etch-a-Sketch is from Phoebe Buffay.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller got the foot massager for Coma Guy.
Phoebe Buffay asks whether Coma Guy knows who shaved Coma Guy.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay shaved Coma Guy.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller read to Coma Guy.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay sang to Coma Guy.
Phoebe Buffay says Coma Guy is welcome.
Coma Guy says Coma Guy will see Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay around.
Phoebe Buffay says Coma Guy's plan to just see Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay around is all he intends to say.
Monica Geller questions that Coma Guy plans to just see Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay around.
Coma Guy asks what Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay want Coma Guy to say.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller does not know what she wants Coma Guy to say.
Monica Geller says Coma Guy should admit something to Monica Geller.
Monica Geller says that what Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay did for Coma Guy was nice.
Coma Guy says Coma Guy will call Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says Coma Guy does not mean that Coma Guy will call Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay.
Monica Geller says this situation is typical.
Monica Geller says Phoebe Buffay knows that this situation is typical.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay give repeatedly.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay get nothing in return.
Monica Geller says Coma Guy wakes up one day.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay should go.
Phoebe Buffay asks Coma Guy if Coma Guy knows what Phoebe Buffay is about to say.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay thought Coma Guy was different.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay guesses Coma Guy only seemed different because of the coma.
